You were right, two of them were real. The build now exits `0`.

Two bugs, both from the shape changes the bump introduced:

- `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. It now reads the new key and falls back to the old one.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it now treats absent as off. A non-boolean value still throws.

I checked both against old and new shapes. Retries resolve to `3`, backoff reports disabled.

The remaining 8 warnings are noise you cannot fix here. They are hardcoded strings in `build.js` and name files that do not exist in this repo, like `src/legacy/adapter.js` and `src/utils/format.js`. Only `src/core` and `src/net` are present.
